_comment: E13 L4 training mix (prereg section 3). Written by revision/tools/make_mix_e13.py draw before any mix file was generated. Do not edit; regenerate the files from this plan.

_method.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(6000) (numpy 2.5.4); for each perturbed file in seed order: base_load = uniform(1.0, 1.4), then the type's parameters in the order listed in bounds; values rounded (base_load, factors and peak_share to 4 decimals, S2 times to 0.1 s)
_method.assignment: perturbed seeds 6031-6060 cycle through S1, S2, S3, S4 (seed 6031 + i -> type i mod 4): S1 and S2 8 files, S3 and S4 7 files
_method.base_load: x1.0 counts (sumo/turn_counts_edges.xml) x base_load per (interval, relation), rounded half to even, total not adjusted (the rule of sumo/turn_counts_12.xml and turn_counts_15.xml); the S-type transform is then applied to these scaled counts
_method.S2_offsets: offset_svobody = (0 + offset_shift) mod 120, offset_prybuzka = (60 + offset_shift) mod 120: both platoon windows move together, the 60-s separation of the test scenario is kept
_method.fixed_from_test: all other scenario parameters are those of revision/demand/scenarios/scenario_params.json (S1 approaches/movements, S2 cycle/background/bin/prefixes/seed offset, S3 peak window)
_method.exclusion: a draw is repeated if base_load == 1.0 or the randomised parameters equal the test scenario's values (S1 factor 1.3; S2 window 40, offsets 0/60; S3 peak_share 0.5; S4 left_factor 1.4)

params.name: directional imbalance
params.rounding: largest remainder over all (interval, relation) cells; scenario total = round_half_up(factor x affected total) + unaffected total; ties go to the earlier cell in file order

params.name: peak formation
params.rounding: per relation: peak_share x relation total spread over the peak intervals and the rest over the other intervals, each in proportion to the relation's observed counts; largest remainder per relation (relation total kept)

params.name: turning-proportion shift
params.rounding: new left = round_half_up(left_factor x left) per interval and approach; through reduced by the same number; shortfall taken from right (logged)
